items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: He had a little job at a beer joint up there and Wayman Carver was playing flute and saxophone, Gary Lee on drums, and Tiny was a bass player.

ctx.x: He had a little job at a beer joint up there and Wayman Carver was playing flute and saxophone, Gary Lee on drums, and Tiny was a bass player. We had a little job over there -- short, short job didn't last too long. That's about the only thing of interest that happened. It was just a short thing, that was before I joined Eddie Heywood.
What about -- were there -- did you have any incidents, like back in the Chicago days, what about the gangsters, they were very --
